question_1.text: What does social engineering mainly target?

choices: A. A fake IT worker asks for your password
B. A website installs an official update
C. A friend sends you a normal game invite
D. A teacher posts an assignment

question_3.text: What should you do if someone claims to be from your school or bank?
choices: A. Use the link or phone number they provide
C. Contact the organization through its official website or number
D. Respond quickly before the request expires

question_4.text: Which action is the best defense against social engineering?
choices: A. Act immediately when a message feels urgent
B. Share more information so the person trusts you
C. Slow down, verify independently, and tell a trusted adult
D. Trust anyone who knows your name and school
